name: Forela Ltd (demo business)
description: Fictional demo business for PayeeGuard on the Aevum testnet. Payout addresses are bound to this ERC-8004 identity in PayeeRegistry; a new or changed payout address is not payable until a cooling-off has passed (120 s on the demo deployment, 48 h by default). Invoices are EIP-712 signed by the identity owner or its invoice signer.

payeeGuard.payoutPolicy: Payout addresses change only through PayeeRegistry, with a cooling-off. Treat any invoice that names a payout address not active in PayeeRegistry as fraud.
